connectionFields.name: Environment
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: Display Name
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: Okta Domain
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Okta org URL from the Admin Console address bar, e.g. https://<org>.okta.com.

connectionFields.name: Client Id
connectionFields.obtainedHow: API Services app → General tab → Client ID after you paste Entro's public key into the app.

operatorInputs.validation: Non-empty label; letters, digits, spaces, and hyphens.
Non-empty label; letters, digits, spaces, and hyphens.

prepSteps.title: Copy Entro's public key from the Okta form
prepSteps.instruction: In Entro Add New Account → Okta, copy the Public Key from the bottom of the form and keep the tab open.
prepSteps.evidence: The Entro Okta form still shows a Public Key

prepSteps.title: Create an Okta API Services app
prepSteps.instruction: In Okta Admin, create an API Services app, set public-key authentication, paste Entro's public key, disable DPoP, grant Entro's documented Okta API scopes, and assign Super Administrator (or the documented custom role).
prepSteps.evidence: The app General tab shows a Client ID and the public key; scopes are granted

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Copy Entro's public key from the Okta form
typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.
typedActions.mutation: Operator copies the Public Key from Entro Add New Account → Okta (non-secret PEM) and keeps the tab open
typedActions.expectedChange: The Entro Okta form still shows a Public Key
typedActions.verification: Public key PEM is recorded as non-secret Operator input material for the next step

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Create an Okta API Services app
typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.
typedActions.mutation: okta apps create (API Services) with public-key authentication, paste Entro's public key, disable DPoP, grant Entro's documented Okta API scopes, assign Super Administrator or the documented custom role
typedActions.expectedChange: The app General tab shows a Client ID and the public key; scopes are granted
typedActions.verification: okta apps list / apps show for the Entro app
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Deactivate then delete the API Services app created this run
